title: galium ciliatum
intro: Galium ciliatum, commonly known as Jateorrhiza or Java bean treacle, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Galium ciliatum include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
